ns2:course.label: Intro to Computing Systems
ns2:course.description: Bits; binary representations; digital logic structures; the von Neumann computing model; an example instruction set; machine and assembly language programming; machine-level input/output; subroutines; the C programming language; variables and operators; control constructs; functions in C; pointers and arrays; input/output in C; recursion; simple data structures. Prerequisite: ECE 110.
